tasks.response: AI-ready datasets to support research in functional genomics, AI/machine learning model training, cellular process analysis, cell architectural changes, and interactions in presence of specific disease processes, treatment conditions, or genetic perturbations. A major goal is to enable biologically-driven, interpretable ML applications, for example as proposed in Ma et al. 2018 (PMID: 29505029) and Kuenzi et al. 2020 (PMID: 33096023).
